symptom: `check -p --references` passed `$r = call microflow AddOn.Request_GetFirst(); declare $s String = $r/Secret;` in an app module while Secret was a Hidden attribute of a Protected (add-on) module; exec wrote it and mxbuild refused CE1406 "Create variable activity 'Create String variable' is not allowed to use attribute 'AddOn.Request.Secret' because app modules cannot reference hidden elements in add-on modules". The same read through a parameter was reported (ako/mxcli#1701, mendixlabs/mxcli#1654).
cause: walkTypedFlow — the one variable-typing walk the --references member checks share — typed parameters, create, retrieve and loop iterators but not the output variable of `call microflow`, so `$r/Secret` had no entity and pathMembers("") returned nothing; the member-existence check (checkFlowMembers in validate_member_refs.go) was blind on call results the same way.
fix: walkTypedFlow takes the scriptContext and types a call's output from the callee's object/list return type via scriptContext.microflowReturnEntity: the script's own definition first (sc.microflows + sc.flowParams), else the stored microflow read by name (microflowsNamed + hierarchy module match), cached per validation pass. validateProtectedModuleRefs now receives the sc validateProgram already builds.
insight: Typing a variable is where a member check's reach is decided — a member check is only as wide as the walk that types its variables, and it fails silent, so widening the walk is the fix, not another check. But a type is a claim: typing from the STORED callee when the script rewrites it with another return type would judge members against the old entity and refuse a correct script (proved by stubbing the script-first branch: the existence check then reported 'Shop.Order has no member Name' for a callee rewritten to return Shop.Customer). So the script's signature must win, and an unresolvable callee must leave the variable untyped. Measured on 11.13.0 (module set Protected via UpdateModuleSettings, one microflow per shape): declare, end event, change on a call result and change on a loop over a returned list all CE1406; the Usable attribute clean.
